title: My Nights with Susan, Olga, Albert, Julie, Piet & Sandra
writer: Carel Donck, Charles Gormley, David Kaufman
actors: Willeke van Ammelrooy, Hans van der Gragt, Nelly Frijda
plot: Anton arrives at Susan's farmhouse in rural Holland to take her away with him. The house and surrounding area is populated by strange characters who duplicitously lust for each other. An opening murder weighs over everything.
